# llama-scripts

> Scripts to configure and run llama.cpp on AMD APU hardware. Self-contained -
> no system ROCm install required. Uses the Synthetic Autonomic Mind fork of
> llama.cpp (with AMD-specific optimizations: Laguna S/DFlash, Lightning Indexer,
> APU tuning). Vulkan (RADV) is the default backend for best stability on
> RDNA3 iGPUs.

## Why

Agentic AI development on AMD APUs without network access. No API keys, no
per-token costs, no cloud dependency. The primary target is a Nimo Axis N161
(Strix Halo, Ryzen AI Max+ 395, Radeon 8060S, 128 GB unified memory). It also
runs on the Ayaneo Flip KB (7840U / 780M / 32 GB) and the Minisforum UM580
(5800H / 16 GB), plus any other AMD APU in the detection map.

## Quick start

```bash
git clone --recurse-submodules https://github.com/fewtarius/llama-scripts.git
cd llama-scripts
./scripts/rebuild.sh
./llama-run.sh --server  # http://localhost:9090
```

## Key features

- Auto GPU/CPU detection (PCI ID + CPU ISA, Cezanne through Strix Halo)
- Build orchestration for Vulkan, ROCm, and Metal backends
- Optimistic-first solver reads GGUF metadata and picks the best config
- GTT/VRAM memory configuration via kernel parameters (capability-based)
- MoE expert tracking, multi-agent parallel slots, reasoning model support
- Model download with split-shard validation and integrity verification

## Repo structure

- `llama-run.sh` - Main entry point (model detection, server launch)
- `scripts/rebuild.sh` - Build (Vulkan default, optional ROCm)
- `scripts/detect-gpu.sh` - AMD GPU auto-detection (PCI ID, CPU ISA)
- `scripts/optimize.sh` - Optimistic-first solver
- `scripts/apply-ttm-kernel-params.sh` - GTT/VRAM kernel parameter configuration
- `scripts/benchmark.sh` - Performance testing with TTFT measurement
- `scripts/install-deps.sh` - System dependency installer
- `scripts/lib-discover-models.sh` - HuggingFace model discovery
- `scripts/read_gguf_kv.py` - GGUF metadata reader
- `scripts/log_analyzer.py` - Benchmark log analysis
- `llama.cpp/` - Submodule (fork of SyntheticAutonomicMind/llama.cpp)
